method: Read saved JSON/Python/NPZ only; independently reconstructed full cache from before-cache, source rows and indices; checked all runtime launch records and metadata; no WSL/GPU.
source_review: Saved grouped source AST matches scaffold plus exactly the three reviewed expressions. NUM_WARPS=4 and ROWS_PER_PROGRAM=4. Prior frozen v1/kernel/checker/contract and previous 1-warp candidate match accepted pins.
launch_review: Every valid nonempty arm submits one kernel; frozen grid=B, grouped grid=ceil(B/4), both num_warps=4. Saved tensor shapes/strides and launch WIDTH/source stride/destination stride/BLOCK_SIZE all match each configuration. Empty wrappers submit zero KV launches.
array_review: All full output caches match independent references including untouched rows and cache guards. Full source arrays including input gap and all indices unchanged. Both arms have identical before and after arrays; all finite.
ownership: Coach demonstrated the three corrected expressions after learner first supplied 0/12/(3). Learner applied/reran the demonstrated solution. Generic saved scaffold ownership wording is not proof of independent implementation or mastery.
failed_fields: Top-level PASS with current_case null; no error/error_type or error.txt; all case and pair states expected.
limitations: Selected C32 FP16/int32 configurations only: nonempty B1/3/4/5/17 with D64 interleaved gap0/guard0, D128 separate gap64/guard0, D192 separate gap64/guard64; two B0 configurations.
This run did not rerun invalid public-input cases and does not cover B256/C1024.
No timing, speedup, model/AMD performance or absence-of-all-invalid-reads claim.
Four logical rows per program with four warps does not prove one physical warp maps to each row.
Correctness of applied demonstrated code does not establish independent learner mastery.
